title: Qualified Accounts to Contact This Week
summary: Find up to five evidence-backed companies, relevant current decision-makers and verified work emails within a $0.50 research ceiling.
outcome: A ranked, human-review-ready prospect list containing company fit evidence, one relevant current person and one verified professional work email per accepted row.
boundary: The Skill does not prove need, budget, timing, buying intent or sales qualification; guarantee five results; infer private emails; send outreach; write to a CRM; or exceed the approved $0.50 ceiling.

catalog_tools.purpose: Build one structured candidate-company pool from the approved ideal-customer profile.
Resolve company identity and find bounded public evidence for hard profile claims.
Extract one selected first-party company page as evidence for fit and identity.
Find a relevant current person and public professional work email for an accepted company.
Verify the selected work email when domain search does not return a sufficiently current valid status.
Confirm the official identity and active status of a UK company when applicable.

inputs: A narrow ideal-customer profile with geography, business type, size and hard exclusions
The offer or problem used to judge company fit
One buyer role or an ordered set of acceptable roles
Existing customer, suppression and do-not-contact domains
outputs: Up to five ranked contact-ready prospects with company fit evidence
One relevant current person and verified professional work email per accepted row
Incomplete and rejected candidates plus a complete research receipt

cost.model: One company-discovery call plus bounded public research, one contact search, conditional email verification and an optional official UK company check per attempted prospect.
cost.notes: At prices inspected on 28 August 2026, the five-row worst-case default is $0.487500; current prices must be re-inspected and re-calculated before every run. Return fewer than five rather than exceed the ceiling.

approvals: Approve the exact ideal-customer profile, exclusions, buyer roles, requested count, paid inputs and maximum before the first metered run
Approve any provider substitution, expanded profile, extra candidate, repeated paid call or spend above the original plan
Review the completed list before any outreach or system-of-record write
compatibility: One authorized Scrollport connection with apps, discover, inspect, run and wallet
A local file or conversation state for resumable research and the final receipt
